_about: v15: the planes' context menu (src/planemenu.js, app.js planeMenuApi). id -> {en, ru, plural?, en_plural?, ctx?, note}. Russian follows notes/i18n/GLOSSARY.md (menu items: perfective infinitive; zero = нуль, pole = полюс, preimage = прообраз, cut = разрез). Read by tools/make_ru_table.py (v15-*.json, after phase2b*).

pm.also_at.note: Muted line under Add zero of fₖ here: where else F_(k-1) takes the same value, e.g. z + 2πik after exp (a family of points).

pm.also_at_one.note: The same with one other point: −z after z², 1/z after Joukowski.

pm.also_preimages.note: The non-injective step is not the first: its input is w₁, e.g. «w₁ + 2πik».

pm.also_infinite.en: also at infinitely many other points
pm.also_infinite.ru: также в бесконечном числе других точек
pm.also_infinite.note: Several non-injective steps, one of them exp.

pm.also_n.note: Rational steps of finite degree before the step: the product of the degrees minus one.

pm.also_maybe.en: other points may map here too
pm.also_maybe.ru: сюда могут переходить и другие точки
pm.also_maybe.note: A non-injective step whose preimages the chain cannot count (a custom formula).

pm.remove_mark.note: Object group on a zero or pole mark; mark is ζ₁ or p₁ (HTML).

pm.edit_mark.note: Focuses the mark's field (card or Inspector).

pm.reset_cut.note: On a cut handle; f is fₖ (HTML).

pm.select.note: The shape under the pointer (GLOSSARY: выделенная фигура).

pm.add_zero_here.note: On the step's own input plane (the step shown alone).

pm.add_pole_here.note: On the step's own input plane.

pm.add_zero_of.note: f is fₖ (HTML): the point becomes a zero of F.

pm.inf_here.note: Muted line of a disabled Add zero item: the step's input is infinite at this point.

pm.add_zp_step.en: Add a zeros-and-poles step with a zero here
pm.add_zp_step.ru: Добавить шаг «Нули и полюсы» с нулём здесь
pm.add_zp_step.note: No zeros-and-poles step in the chain yet.

pm.added_zp_step.en: Added a zeros-and-poles step with a zero at {z}
pm.added_zp_step.ru: Добавлен шаг «Нули и полюсы» с нулём в точке %{z}

pm.add_point.note: A point shape (a target on Y).

pm.copied_value.note: Toast; value is the copied number (with the point, as fields take it).

pm.center_here.note: View group: the plane's view centre moves to the point.
